_comment: Canonical behaviour of parseAmountToKobo, shared between this repo and the
The two are separate files in separate repositories, and PRD section 3 says
the backend owns the authoritative copy and that the two must not drift. This
file is how that is enforced: copy it into both repos alongside the parser,
run it from both test suites, and a disagreement about what '350k' means
fails a test instead of reaching a client's invoice.
Values are integer kobo. null means unparseable.

_notes.0.001: finer than a kobo, so refused rather than rounded
_notes.-350k: no negative invoices; a credit note is a different document
_notes.350 k: people type a space before the suffix, and mean the same thing
